name: Omron CP2E Compact PLC, 30 I/O
description: Compact CP2E S-type programmable logic controller with 30 built-in I/O points (18 DC inputs, 12 PNP transistor outputs) and a 24 V DC supply. Suited to standalone machines and small production lines.

name: INVT GD27 AC Drive 0.75 kW (Conventional Type)
description: GD27 series general-purpose variable frequency drive, 0.75 kW, single-phase 230 V input, with built-in braking unit. Compact drive for fans, pumps, conveyors and packaging machinery.

name: Omron NB7W 7" Touchscreen HMI
description: 7-inch widescreen colour TFT touch panel (800 × 480) with Ethernet, USB and serial ports. Configured with NB-Designer and pairs with Omron CP-series PLCs.

name: Omron CP1W Analog I/O Unit, 2 In / 2 Out
description: Expansion unit with 2 analog inputs and 2 analog outputs for Omron CP-series controllers. Used for transmitters, valves and drive speed references.

name: Communication Cable 1.5 m
description: 1.5 m communication cable (part 751107) for PLC programming and panel-to-controller links.

name: Omron S8FS-C 350 W Power Supply, 24 V DC

name: Omron S82Y DIN-Rail Mounting Bracket
description: DIN-rail mounting bracket for S8FS-C series power supplies.

name: Omron E2B M12 Inductive Proximity Sensor, 2 m
description: M12 shielded inductive proximity sensor, 4 mm sensing distance, PNP NO output, 2 m pre-wired cable. Non-contact detection of metal targets.

name: Omron E5CC Digital Temperature Controller
description: 48 × 48 mm digital temperature controller with relay control output, two alarm outputs and universal (thermocouple / RTD) input, 100–240 V AC.

name: L&T MNX 9 A Contactor, 1 NO, 240 V 50 Hz
description: MNX series three-pole power contactor rated 9 A (AC-3) with one auxiliary NO contact and a 240 V AC, 50 Hz coil. For motor starters and load switching.

name: L&T MN2 Thermal Overload Relay, 3–5 A
description: MN2 thermal overload relay with 3–5 A setting range. Mounts directly on MNX contactors for motor overload protection.

name: Industrial Ethernet Cable
description: Industrial Ethernet patch cable with RJ45 connectors for PLC, HMI and switch connections.

name: Phoenix Contact FL SWITCH 1005N

description: M18 cylindrical photoelectric sensor, diffuse-reflective, PNP output. Detects objects on conveyors and machines.

name: Control Module VS0-70QE
description: Industrial electronic control module, model VS0-70QE. Contact our team for the datasheet and compatibility details.

name: Control Unit 90077-00007VS-102QS

name: Optex DM-18TN RGB Colour / Mark Sensor

name: Automation Component DK-20-9,5/110/124
